claims.quote: Jinshaia sinensis is a balitorid loach known only from the Jinsha river basin, the westernmost headwater tributary of the Yangtze in China.
Known only from the Yangtze (also known as Chang Jiang) river system in China, specifically the Jinsha river basin, its westernmost headwater tributary.
